paragraphs.neutral: You do not consume salmon. We can only congratulate you and encourage you to spread this message around you.
paragraphs.low: You consume about {totalConsoInKg}kg of salmon per year. You are already on the right track. Next step: zero goal!
paragraphs.medium: You consume about {totalConsoInKg}kg of salmon per year. By replacing a part of your consumption with one of the proposed alternatives, you are already significantly reducing your impact.
paragraphs.high: You consume about {totalConsoInKg}kg of salmon per year. Salmon is part of your habits, and this is exactly where each replaced meal counts the most to reduce your impact.
paragraphs.veryHigh: You consume about {totalConsoInKg}kg of salmon per year. Your room for improvement is the greatest, and cutting your consumption in half would already have a real impact on the ocean.

step2.title: Reduce its frequency
step2.caption: Today it's {frequency} x a year. Tomorrow?

info.algae: Algae are cultivated without fishmeal, fertilizer, or freshwater. And the omega-3s we look for in salmon are originally produced by microalgae. An industry to grow on our coasts.
info.plantBasedSmokedSalmon: The pleasure of smoked salmon, without intensive farming. Plant-based alternatives are multiplying and improving fast. The right reflex: turn the package around and choose a short ingredient list.
info.shellfish: Mussels and oysters feed by filtering seawater, thus without fishmeal or fish oil. They also provide iron, zinc, and B12. Their health depends on that of our coastal waters.
info.plantBasedProtein: Lentils, chickpeas, and beans are rich in protein and fiber, inexpensive, and easy to store. Nutritional recommendations suggest eating them at least twice a week.
info.trout: Replacing salmon with trout is a false good idea. Salmon and trout are cousins: two carnivores intensively farmed and fed with meal and oil from wild fish.
info.tuna: Replacing with tuna is a false good idea. It is an apex predator that concentrates mercury. Industrial tuna fishing leads to the bycatch of sharks, turtles, and dolphins.

info.fishOil: False good idea: fish oil comes from the same anchovy and sardine fisheries that feed farmed salmon. And the omega-3s it contains were initially produced by microalgae. Try the other ingredients!

neutral.title: Super salmon
neutral.caption: Wow, well done! You are right at the beginning of becoming quite strong, probably, if ambition accompanies you in this little transformation: a very large Atlantic salmon!

low.title: Great salmon
low.caption: Congratulations, you are on your way to becoming quite strong, probably, if ambition accompanies you in this little transformation: a very large Atlantic salmon!

medium.title: Teen Salmon (smolt)
medium.caption: Well done! You are well on your way, a smolt as scientists say, and probably, if ambition accompanies you in this little transformation: a very large salmon!

high.title: Baby salmon
high.caption: You are a salmon alevin, you successfully hatched. Not bad at all! Now you will have to be brave to hold on until the end. Hang in there, we need salmon like you.

veryHigh.title: Salmon seed
veryHigh.caption: Like a salmon egg on the gravel of a mountain river, you can become a beautiful salmon, but for that, the road will be long, you will have to double your efforts to reach the next level!
